text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Ines Fujin is trembling with sheer anticipation. I can tell she's even more excited now than she was before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us have chased her dream this far, and I bet at the Japan Cup she's going to show me where it goes next!
